{"consolidated_memory":"## Message redelivery issues in worker/queue/consumer.py

The consumer experienced message redelivery (same message id handled more than once) on two separate occasions:

### Incident 1 - [2026-07-14]
- **Component**: worker/queue/consumer.py
- **Trigger**: Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- **Repro**: Kill worker mid-batch and restart
- **Signal**: Same message id handled more than once
- **Root cause**: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- **Fix**: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- **PR/Branch**: PR #3003 on branch fix/message-redelivery-2
- **Result**: 10 duplicate rows per day stopped being written
- **Context**: This was the same corner of worker/queue/consumer.py as earlier message redelivery work

### Incident 2 - [2026-08-23]
- **Component**: worker/queue/consumer.py
- **Trigger**: After a rolling restart of the fleet
- **Repro**: Kill worker mid-batch and restart
- **Signal**: Same message id handled more than once
- **Root cause**: Schema drift between the migration and the model
- **Fix**: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- **PR/Branch**: PR #3749 on branch fix/message-redelivery-4
- **Result**: Error rate dropped from 1.9% to under 4 per 10,000
- **Testing**: Covered by tests/worker/test_consumer.py
- **Stack**: Python

Note: Both incidents manifested identically but had different root causes. The config loader issue was fixed first; the schema drift issue was a separate occurrence discovered after fleet restart."}
